title: How much does each animal weigh?
prompt: Place each animal from lightest to heaviest.

items.label: A honeybee
items.fact: A foraging honeybee weighs about a tenth of a gram and can carry near its own weight in nectar.

items.label: A house cat
items.fact: A healthy domestic cat is usually 4–5 kg.

items.label: A giant panda
items.fact: Pandas eat up to 12 kg of bamboo a day to sustain that bulk.

items.label: A polar bear
items.fact: The largest land carnivore — big males can approach 700 kg.

items.label: A hippopotamus
items.fact: Despite their bulk, hippos can outrun a human over short distances.

items.label: A blue whale
items.fact: The heaviest animal ever known — heavier than the largest dinosaurs.
